# CaloriePilot

CaloriePilot is a free website providing online calorie and fitness calculators.

## Main tools
- Calorie Calculator: /calorie-calculator.html
- BMR Calculator: /bmr-calculator.html
- TDEE Calculator: /tdee-calculator.html
- BMI Calculator: /bmi-calculator.html
- Calorie Deficit Calculator: /calorie-deficit-calculator.html
- Macro Calculator: /macro-calculator.html
- Protein Calculator: /protein-calculator.html

## Guides
- Calorie Calculator Guide: /calorie-calculator-guide.html
- Daily Calorie Needs Guide: /daily-calorie-needs-guide.html
- BMR vs TDEE: /bmr-vs-tdee.html
- How Many Calories Do I Need?: /how-many-calories-do-i-need.html
- How to Calculate a Calorie Deficit: /how-to-calculate-calorie-deficit.html
- How Much Protein Do I Need?: /how-much-protein-do-i-need.html
- Macro Calculator Guide: /macro-calculator-guide.html

## Notes
Calculator results are estimates based on commonly used formulas and are not medical advice.
